_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your Informatica repository (Oracle) connection details. Never commit config.json with real credentials to source control.

options._schema_prefix_note: If the repository tables/views live under a specific schema and your user doesn't default to it, set e.g. 'INFA_REPO.' (with trailing dot). Leave '' if not needed.

thick_mode._lib_dir_note: Set to the Oracle Instant Client directory if it is not already on PATH/LD_LIBRARY_PATH, e.g. 'C:/oracle/instantclient_21_12' or '/opt/oracle/instantclient_21_12'. null = auto-detect.
